falsifiers: any stock-path output divergence before the first TARGET_VERIFY
any cache-location mismatch or stale accepted stock K/V
graph recapture or host synchronization caused by phase dispatch
gates: stock prefill and pre-verification ordinary decode are bit-exact to control
all 384 logical rows use proxy only at converted layers
padded rows never allocate or write cache slots
both banks survive identical accept/move/free operations
post-accept stock-operator decode is finite and matches the eager hybrid reference
net component saving remains positive after shadow maintenance
steps: Populate stock and proxy-local caches from one exact c32 4,214-token prefill.
Run one stock ordinary-decode row and require control equivalence.
Replay one depth-12 TARGET_VERIFY graph with 384 logical rows.
Apply one synthetic accepted-index pattern to both banks, then compare one stock-operator decode with an eager dual-cache reference.

limitations: The phase dispatcher and maintenance model are not a GPU measurement.
A narrow K/V-only GEMM may fall outside both width-scaling bounds.
The zero ordinary-decode-step scenario matches the speculative target-only accounting; callers must set nonzero steps for a mixed ordinary-decode workload.
No launch, allocator, cache-move, or graph-recapture overhead is credited beyond the stated projection and HBM terms.

decision: Retain for one later exact-c32 component falsification. The source-complete dispatcher isolates the proxy to TARGET_VERIFY, but safe stock fallback requires mirrored dual-cache maintenance.

first_expected_target_decision_divergenc.location: TARGET_VERIFY layer 11 attention output, before its residual addition; the 4,214-token prompt already exceeds the proxy's 1,024-token receptive field.
telemetry: forward mode, graph capture batch, logical and padded rows
layer-11 stock/proxy attention-output max and relative error
per-request target top-1/top-k logits and accepted draft count
accepted indices plus stock/proxy cache locations before/after move
post-accept stock-decode logits versus an eager dual-cache reference

mechanism.cache_semantics: Both banks receive allocation/write/move/free events. Stock modes write proxy-local shadow K/V so later verification has its 1,024-token history. TARGET_VERIFY writes stock-global shadow K/V so accepted rows remain valid for later stock decode. Rejected speculative rows are freed from both banks. After the first converted layer diverges, later stock-shadow K/V are computed from hybrid hidden state; returning to stock operators does not restore all-stock semantics.
mechanism.cuda_graph_boundary: The speculative runner captures a distinct TARGET_VERIFY graph with batch_size*tokens_per_request rows, so the Python mode branch is capture-static. Replay changes tensor values and logical size, not the selected attention module.

TARGET_VERIFY.graph_contract: capture_static_target_verify_branch; replay updates values and logical-row count; padded rows perform no cache write

geometry.consequence: Stock K/V cannot be reinterpreted as proxy-local K/V; projection shapes, RoPE, head geometry, and cache layout differ.

mechanism.row_ownership: ForwardMode is scalar per ForwardBatch. TARGET_VERIFY owns all request-major logical rows [request][draft_token]; at c32 depth12 this is 384 rows. Captured padding rows own no request and perform no cache write.
